title: A geometric approach to the density of rank-metric codes
summary: We study the asymptotic density of $\mathbb{F}_q$-point-free linear sections of geometrically irreducible projective varieties over finite fields. We then apply these results to rank-metric codes via determinantal varieties. Our approach recovers the known cases in which the density tends to $0$ or $1$ and determines the limit in the cases where it was previously unknown. To compute these previously unknown limits, we extend the notion of quasireflexivity to higher-dimensional varieties and show that determinantal varieties satisfy this property.
